hairline.appliesTo: cream circle outline, light surfaces only

type.note: Wordmark ships as outlines; no font needed to render logo files.

rules.clearSpace: Minimum clear space on all sides = radius of the large orange circle (34 units / 17% of mark width).
rules.hairlineClamp: Below ~114px the 1.5pt hairline is clamped to 1 device px so it stays visible.
